event.description: Test final feed-forward bottleneck boundary at width 7
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 3,488 parameters at 99.630000%, a +0.630000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 7 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0009, ff_dim=8 at 3,488 parameters and 99.63% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0011, an optimization failure for ff_dim=6 that reached 98.65% internal validation without a checkpoint or official score. Hypothesis: the capacity transition may occur at the single remaining integer width 7; reducing ff_dim 8->7 is parameterization-preserving compression removing 64 parameters. This is more informative than any nearest alternative in the family because it completes the exact bracket between accepted width 8 and failed width 6 under identical representation, schedule, and stopping conditions.
